assets.name: iceberg
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent PNG obstacle sprite for a simplified 2D maritime cargo game, rendered about 170 x 150 logical pixels
Primary request: One angular iceberg floating at the ocean surface, viewed side-on with slight 3/4 depth, in a clean stylized flat/isometric 2D game illustration.
Subject: A single large asymmetrical triangular ice mass with one pointed peak and a broad underwater base visible. The implied waterline is at about 70% of the sprite height, expressed in the object itself without a surrounding water rectangle.
Style/medium: Simple crisp faceted shape design, restrained details, sharp readable silhouette that harmonizes with a simplified game ship; no outline, or exceptionally thin clean outlines.
Composition/framing: Square sprite, object centered with about 5% transparent margin. Show the entire iceberg including broad lower submerged base.
Lighting/mood: Cool light from top left, bright frosted edges.
Color palette: Pale icy cyan faces, bright icy highlights, restrained teal shadow facets. Must read clearly over navy/teal #193f53 ocean and #0c2537 water.
Scene/backdrop: Truly transparent background with preserved alpha everywhere outside the iceberg; no painted background.
Constraints: Exactly one iceberg; clean simple faceted shape, no other objects.
Avoid: Sky, ocean or sea rectangles, horizon, ship, characters, text, logos, watermark, backdrop, checkerboard painted into image, excessive texture, glow or drop shadow outside object.
assets.visualNotes: Single faceted angular iceberg with broad submerged base and true transparent background. The generated waterline is around the middle of sprite height, rather than requested 70%.

assets.name: maritime-debris
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent PNG obstacle sprite for a simplified 2D maritime cargo game, rendered about 120 x 45 logical pixels
Primary request: One small floating piece of maritime debris: a long weathered broken timber/log with a short diagonal splinter and attached frayed rope.
Style/medium: Clean stylized flat/isometric 2D game illustration, side view with slight 3/4 depth. Simple crisp faceted shape design with restrained details, harmonizing with a simplified game ship.
Composition/framing: Compact horizontal silhouette; entire single connected timber debris assembly centered with about 5% transparent margin. Landscape sprite.
Lighting/mood: Cool top-left lighting with readable warm highlights.
Color palette: Muted warm amber/brown highlighted timber faces, restrained teal shaded faces, frayed rope in muted tan. Must read clearly over navy/teal #193f53 ocean and #0c2537 water.
Materials/textures: Weathered broken wood with simple grain indications and jagged ends, one short diagonal splinter, attached loosely frayed rope. Only a few subtle water droplets around the object.
Scene/backdrop: Truly transparent background with preserved alpha outside the object and the few droplets; no painted background.
Constraints: Exactly one compact debris sprite, clean readable silhouette at small game size, no outline or exceptionally thin clean outlines.
Avoid: Sky, ocean or sea rectangles, horizon, ship, characters, text, logos, watermark, backdrop, checkerboard painted into image, extra separate debris pieces, excessive texture, glow or drop shadow outside object.
assets.visualNotes: Single horizontal broken timber with short diagonal splinter, frayed rope and small water droplets. True transparent background. Texture is more detailed than a flat simplified game illustration.
